'''Darth Nul's Laboratory'''<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Darth Nul's Laboratory}}</ref> was a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], beneath the [[Temple of Nul]]. The library belonged to [[Darth Nul]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Library of Nul" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> the [[Eternal Alliance]] conducted an investigation of the laboratory and retrieved recordings of Darth Nul.<ref name="The Library of Nul" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Nul's Laboratory first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
